title: Dakka language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Sulawesi, Indonesia
extract: Dakka is an endangered Austronesian language of Sulawesi, Indonesia. It is spoken in the Wonomulyo district of Polewali Mandar Regency, and belongs to the Northern branch of the South Sulawesi subgroup.
